title: RFK Jr.'s new food pyramid puts meat, cheese and vegetables at the top
summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has announced new dietary guidelines for Americans focused on promoting whole foods, healthy proteins and fats. And he has "declared war" on sugar.
contentText:
Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has announced new dietary guidelines for Americans focused on promoting whole foods, healthy proteins and fats. And he has "declared war" on sugar.
